candidates.name: H_xMoO3 (hydrogen molybdenum bronze, x~0.3-1.7) -- METALLIC d-band, O-H...O bridge
candidates.metallic: YES at 1 atm (mixed-valence Mo5+/Mo6+; H-bronze is a known metallic/highly-conducting bronze for the blue/monoclinic phases; Fermi level in Mo 4d). LIT
candidates.mott: NO -- wide Mo 4d band (W~2-3 eV), x non-integer -> off-half-filling, U/W<1. LIT/EST
candidates.note: Live carrier (metallic), but the bronze O-H...O is the WEAKER/LONGER asymmetric bond -> smaller dt/du than kappa-H3's short symmetric bridge. The inverse trade.

candidates.name: H_xWO3 (hydrogen tungsten bronze, x~0.1-0.5) -- METALLIC 5d-band, O-H...O bridge
candidates.metallic: YES at 1 atm (E_F well in W 5d conduction band; classic metallic bronze, blue/colored, partially-filled 5d). LIT
candidates.mott: NO -- wide W 5d band (W~3-4 eV), x continuous, U/W<<1. LIT
candidates.note: Most robustly metallic bronze (W5d wide band) -- but widest band = smallest g/t (strong-metal limit: the proton barely perturbs a 3-4 eV band).
